queues._comment: batchSize is a COST control, not a throughput one. The analyze function spends nearly all of its wall-clock awaiting AOAI, and Flex Consumption bills instance memory x wall-clock. At batchSize 4 each instance held only 4 in-flight model calls and idled on I/O wait for the rest of every instance-second, which is why compute ($191.86) ran ~2x the model spend ($97.30) on a workload whose only real work is calling a model. Raising concurrency overlaps the waits so the same work costs materially fewer instance-seconds. Measured 2026-08-15; record before/after cost-per-item.
